standard.name: ISO 22163 (IRIS)
standard.description: Railway Applications - Railway Quality Management System - Business Management System Requirements for Rail Organizations (ISO 9001:2015 and Particular Requirements for Application in the Rail Sector)

categories.name: Railway Requirements
categories.description: Railway-specific quality management requirements based on ISO 9001:2015

clauses.title: Context of the Organization
clauses.description: Organizational context, business planning, social responsibility
clauses.helpText: Railway industry context including stakeholders and regulatory environment

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.description: Leadership commitment, policy, roles and responsibilities
clauses.helpText: Management commitment to railway quality and safety

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Risk-based planning, quality objectives, planning for changes
clauses.helpText: Railway project planning with risk management

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Resources, competence (railway-specific), awareness, communication, documented information

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Operational planning, project management, innovation, configuration management, product safety, RAMS, LCC
clauses.helpText: Railway operations with emphasis on safety and lifecycle management

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.description: Planning and control of railway operational processes
clauses.helpText: Railway project planning and execution controls

clauses.title: Innovation management
clauses.description: Process for managing innovation in railway products and services
clauses.helpText: Innovation processes for railway technology advancement

clauses.title: Project management
clauses.description: Project management processes for railway projects
clauses.helpText: Railway project management methodology, milestones, deliverables

clauses.title: Project review management
clauses.description: Reviews of railway project progress and performance

clauses.title: Configuration management and change control
clauses.description: Control over railway product configuration throughout lifecycle
clauses.helpText: Configuration baseline management, change control for railway products

clauses.title: Product safety
clauses.description: Integration of product safety requirements in railway projects
clauses.helpText: Railway safety requirements integration (EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129)

clauses.title: RAMS and LCC
clauses.description: Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety (RAMS) and Life Cycle Costing (LCC)
clauses.helpText: RAMS analysis per EN 50126, lifecycle cost analysis for railway systems

clauses.title: Requirements for products and services
clauses.description: Customer communication, determination and review of railway product requirements
clauses.helpText: Railway customer requirements capture and contract review

clauses.title: Design and development
clauses.description: Design and development of railway products and services
clauses.helpText: Railway design controls, verification and validation

clauses.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
clauses.description: Supplier management for railway supply chain
clauses.helpText: Railway supplier evaluation, approval, and monitoring

clauses.title: Production and service provision
clauses.description: Control of railway production and service delivery
clauses.helpText: Railway manufacturing and assembly controls, installation, commissioning

clauses.title: Performance Evaluation
clauses.description: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation, internal audit, management review
clauses.helpText: Railway project and process performance monitoring

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Continual improvement, nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.helpText: Continuous improvement in railway quality management
